title: WarehouseRecoveryManifest
description: Schema for a machine-readable Warehouse node recovery manifest. A recovery manifest describes everything needed to deterministically rebuild a node from authority sources. Status: candidate v0.1 authority: provisional.

manifest_id.description: Unique identifier for this recovery manifest.

node.description: Name of the node or system component this manifest describes.

created_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when this manifest was authored.

authority_sources.description: Ordered list of canonical authority sources consulted during recovery. These are truth; reflections are not.

required_repos.description: Git repositories that must be present on the node for recovery to succeed.

required_configs.description: Configuration files that must exist or be restored before the node is operational.

required_agents.description: Agent runtimes that must be running or launchable after recovery.

verification_steps.description: Ordered list of steps to verify the node has been successfully recovered. Each step must be independently checkable.

check.description: A shell command or logical assertion that returns 0 on success.

rebuild_steps.description: Ordered list of steps to rebuild the node from scratch using authority sources only.

action.description: Shell command or procedure to execute.

depends_on.description: Step numbers that must complete before this step runs.

lineage_ref.description: Artifact ID of the lineage record for this manifest (references LINEAGE_SCHEMA.json).

notes.description: Free-text notes about this manifest or known recovery caveats.
